name: SuGaR
aliases: SuGaR: Surface-Aligned Gaussian Splatting for Realistic Head Avatar Reconstruction
definition: A method that builds 3D surfaces from multi-view images using the 3DGS representation by introducing a self-regularization loss to constrain the distance between the camera and the closest Gaussian to match the pixel's depth value in the rendered depth map.
summary: SuGaR is a post-hoc method that extracts high-quality triangle meshes from 3D Gaussian Splatting by aligning Gaussians to a surface, enabling mesh-based editing while maintaining real-time rendering.
